title: 第3章 却仍可仰望星辰第4章 无名尸
slug: 从一证永证开始成神第432章
content_zh:
;;
叶霄盯着那张纸，半晌没动。
他没有被吓住，只在心里一笔笔往下算。
片刻后，他先把脚掌往冻土里又压了一下。
裂开的脚底立刻钻出一阵疼，直冲牙根。
可那股劲没散。
再压一次，膝弯还是酸，腿却稳得出奇。昨夜那种下一刻就要塌下去的虚感，已经退了大半。
这才是最要紧的东西。
叶霄弯腰，把那张写着“九”的纸捡起来，折好，塞进袖口最深处。
九天。
他缓缓吐出一口白气，眼底更冷了些。
“天道酬勤，一证永证……”
他低低念了一遍，把这八个字死死记进心里。
寻常人练桩，入门难。
练轻了没用。
练重了，先伤身，再伤根。
可他不一样。
昨夜那股差点把胸口勒断的窒息感还在。
可这具身体，已经稳了下来。
底子没垮。

反而被硬生生砸实了一层。
叶霄扶着墙站起来，腰背一紧，双腿仍旧发酸，却已经不再发虚。他把冻僵的手在裤腿上狠狠搓了两下，等麻意退了一些，才推门回屋。
屋里昏黄的油灯还在晃，火苗忽明忽暗。
母亲靠着墙打盹，被门响惊醒，连忙撑着身子坐直一些：
“霄儿？”
“我回来了。”
叶霄走到床边，先伸手摸了摸小雪的额头，眉头微微皱起：
“还烫，但比昨夜匀一点。”
母亲看见他冻得发红的手腕，脸色顿时变了：
“你昨晚不会一直在外头吧？你这身子，经不起这么折腾。”
“没待太久。”
叶霄摇了摇头，把整夜站桩这件事压了下去，半个字都没露。
母亲犹豫了一下，轻声道：
“要不今天别出门了？哑巷最近不太对。”
“不能不去。”
叶霄摇头，看了一眼门缝里透进来的灰光，声音发沉：
“家里剩下的钱，撑不过几天了。”
说这话时，他胃里轻轻抽了一下。
不是疼。
是饿。

他下意识抿了抿唇，把那点反应压了回去，没让它露在脸上。随后端起旁边那碗凉水，几口灌下去。凉水顺着喉咙往下割，他也只是咽着。
在哑巷，连难受都得往回收。
披上破棉衣前，他又活动了一下发酸的手脚。
content_en:
;;
Ye Xiao stared at the piece of paper and didn't move for a long time.
He was not intimidated, and just kept calculating in his mind.
After a while, he pressed the soles of his feet into the frozen soil first.
A burst of pain immediately shot through the cracked sole of the foot, straight to the root of the tooth.
But the energy didn't dissipate.
I pressed it again, my knees were still sore, but my legs were surprisingly stable. The feeling that I was going to collapse the next moment last night has mostly subsided.
This is the most important thing.
Ye Xiao bent down, picked up the piece of paper with "Nine" written on it, folded it, and stuffed it into the deepest part of his sleeve.
Nine days.
He slowly exhaled a breath of white air, and his eyes became colder.
"God rewards hard work, one certificate lasts forever..."
He read it in a low voice and memorized these eight words in his heart.
It is difficult for ordinary people to get started practicing Zhuang.
It’s useless to practice lightly.
If you practice too hard, you will hurt your body first and then your roots.
But he is different.
The suffocating feeling that nearly broke my chest last night was still there.
But this body has stabilized.
The foundation is not broken.
Instead, it was smashed into a solid layer.
Ye Xiao stood up holding on to the wall, his waist and back tightened. His legs were still sore, but they were no longer weak. He rubbed his frozen hands on his trouser legs twice, and after the numbness subsided a little, he opened the door and went back to the house.
The dim oil lamp in the room was still flickering, and the flame flickered on and off.
My mother was napping against the wall and was awakened by the sound of the door. She quickly propped herself up and sat up straighter:
"Xiao'er?"
"I'm back."
Ye Xiao walked to the bed, first reached out and touched Xiaoxue's forehead, frowning slightly:
"Still hot, but a little warmer than last night."
When his mother saw his wrists that were red from the cold, her expression suddenly changed:
"You weren't going out all the time last night, were you? Your body can't withstand such a torment."
"Didn't stay long."
Ye Xiao shook his head and suppressed the matter of standing around all night without revealing a single word.
Mother hesitated for a moment and said softly:
"Why don't you go out today? Something's not going right in Yaxiang lately."
"Can't not go."
Ye Xiao shook his head, glanced at the gray light coming from the crack in the door, and said in a deep voice:
"The money left at home can't last more than a few days."
His stomach twitched slightly as he said this.
It's not pain.
It's hunger.
He pursed his lips subconsciously, suppressing the reaction and not letting it show on his face. Then he picked up the bowl of cold water next to him and drank a few sips of it. The cold water cut down his throat, and he just swallowed.
In the dumb alley, even the discomfort has to be taken away.
Before putting on the tattered cotton clothes, he moved his aching hands and feet again.
